notes: Garvan Acoustic (singular, .com) is the manufacturer. They make BOTH architectural speakers (Coro, Luna, Loto, Goccia, Celeste collections) AND acoustic panels (Architectural Acoustic Solutions: Atelier, CinemAtelier, Acoustic Parquet, Microbaffle, Quadra, Sound Quadra, Surface). All product datasheets follow the consistent URL pattern https://www.garvanacoustic.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/{SKU}_Datasheet.pdf and were spot-verified. The KA*H series (KA112H, KA213H, KA313H, KA316H, KA320H, KA520H) and WA220H / WA130H are the speaker / subwoofer variants integrated into Atelier panels (CinemAtelier product family) — their image URLs were extracted directly from the CinemAtelier page. Per the tag allowlist (only 'acoustic-sound-panels' is allowed), the Product Tags field is set only for acoustic panel / panel-integrated speaker products; for pure speakers / subwoofers the tag value is omitted because no allowlisted value applies. Product Categories is 'audio' across the board.

existing_updates.title: KR107
existing_updates.Description:
KR107 slim in-wall and in-ceiling speaker

The Garvan Acoustic KR107 is a slim, full-range in-wall speaker from the Luna collection. Engineered for architects and installers who demand a discreet, plastic-free, flush-mounted speaker, the KR107 disappears into the architecture while delivering clear, natural sound. The narrow 11 cm baffle hides behind a magnetic fabric or perforated steel cover so the only visible element is a refined trim that aligns with the surrounding wall finish.

  • Full-range driver tuned for music and voice
  • Plastic-free metal frame, flush to plasterboard or masonry walls
  • Removable magnetic cover available in fabric, RAL/NCS-painted steel, brushed stainless or Corten
  • Designed for Multiroom and home cinema surround installations

The KR107 ships with a pre-construction box for fast, clean integration into both new builds and renovations.

The AT432-D is a Garvan Acoustic 4-channel power amplifier built around a Powersoft DSP platform with Dante / AES67 networked audio input. It delivers 320 W total output and adds full DSP control (input matrix, EQ, delay, limiter, frequency-range) on top of network audio, so it slots cleanly into IP-based installations in offices, hotels, and venues.

  • 4 channels, 320 W total power
  • Powersoft amplifier with onboard DSP
  • Dante / AES67 network audio input
  • Compatible with 8, 4 and 2 Ω loads without power loss

Part of Garvan's AT-series amplifier family, specifically the Dante / AES67 variant alongside AT460-D, AT2404-A and AT4804-A.

AT460-A 4-channel amplifier

It delivers 600 W total output across four channels, with onboard DSP for input matrix, EQ, delay, limiter and frequency-range management. Designed to drive both speaker and passive subwoofer channels in higher-power surround and multi-zone installations.

  • 4 channels, 600 W total power
  • Powersoft amplifier platform with onboard DSP
  • Input matrix, EQ, delay, limiter, frequency-range control
  • Compatible with 8, 4 and 2 Ω loads without power loss

Part of Garvan's AT-series amplifier family alongside AT232-A, AT260-A, AT432-A, AT432-D, AT460-D, AT2404-A and AT4804-A.

new_products.title: SA225
new_products.Description:
SA225 outdoor 360° speaker

The SA225 is a Garvan Acoustic Loto-series outdoor 360° speaker in a Corian® cabinet. Built for gardens, terraces and pool decks, it delivers omnidirectional natural sound from a compact, weather-resistant enclosure. The Corian® cabinet is available in custom colours and can be installed as a free-standing object or on a Garvan floor stand.

  • Outdoor 360° speaker, Corian® cabinet
  • Weather-resistant construction
  • Optional Garvan HRX031 floor stand
  • Part of the Loto outdoor family alongside SA117, SN116, SN117, SN120, SN220, WA125, WA138, WN120

new_products.title: SA117
new_products.Description:
SA117 outdoor 360° speaker

The SA117 is a Garvan Acoustic Loto-series outdoor 360° speaker designed for gardens, terraces and pool decks. The compact cabinet is built with weather-resistant materials and delivers omnidirectional natural sound that fills the surrounding space without a directional sweet spot. Available in multiple finishes including white, green, grey and Corten® effect.

  • Outdoor 360° speaker
  • Weather-resistant construction
  • Multiple finish options including Corten® effect
  • Part of the Loto outdoor family alongside SA225, SN116, SN117, SN120, SN220, WA125, WA138, WN120

new_products.title: SN117
new_products.Description:
SN117 outdoor loudspeakers

The SN117 is a Garvan Acoustic Loto-series outdoor loudspeaker for gardens, terraces and pool decks. The compact weather-resistant cabinet delivers natural 360° sound and is available in multiple finishes including white, green, grey and Corten® effect. Optional white or RGB LED lighting is available for accent lighting in landscape installations.

  • Outdoor 360° loudspeaker
  • Weather-resistant construction
  • Optional white / RGB LED accent lighting
  • Part of the Loto outdoor family alongside SA117, SA225, SN116, SN120, SN220, WA125, WA138, WN120

new_products.title: WN120
new_products.Description:
WN120 outdoor subwoofer

The WN120 is a Garvan Acoustic Loto-series outdoor subwoofer designed for gardens, terraces and pool decks. The weather-resistant cabinet delivers deep low-frequency support for outdoor 360° speakers such as the SN116, SN117 and SN120, completing the bass register for outdoor music and entertainment systems.

  • Outdoor subwoofer for the Loto family
  • Weather-resistant construction
  • Pairs with SN-series Loto outdoor speakers
  • Available in multiple finishes

new_products.title: Atelier
new_products.Description:
Atelier decorative acoustic panel

Atelier is Garvan Acoustic's flagship decorative acoustic panel collection, manufactured to Italian sartorial standards. Each panel is tailor-made: dimensions, fabric, colour and graphic print are specified on a per-project basis. Atelier panels are used to reduce reverberation and improve speech and music clarity in residential, hospitality, office and acoustic-treatment projects while integrating with interior design themes rather than competing with them.

  • Tailor-made decorative acoustic panel
  • Custom dimensions and graphic prints
  • Trevira CS yarn fabrics, wide finish range
  • Part of the Architectural Acoustic Solutions collection alongside Microbaffle, Acoustic Parquet, Quadra, Surface, Sound Quadra and CinemAtelier

Used in residential, hospitality, retail and corporate projects where acoustic treatment must be visually refined.

new_products.title: Surface
new_products.Description:
Surface sound-absorbing panel

Surface is a Garvan Acoustic sound-absorbing panel inspired by the cladding slabs used on large buildings. The panel can be specified as a wall-mounted, ceiling-mounted, freestanding or desk-mounted sound absorber, making it one of the most flexible items in the Architectural Acoustic Solutions catalogue. Finishes include MatericaCement™ concrete effect, custom paint, graphic printing and fabric.

  • Multi-mount sound-absorbing panel (wall, ceiling, freestanding, desk)
  • Trevira CS yarn fabric and MatericaCement™ finish options
  • Custom graphic printing available
  • Part of the Architectural Acoustic Solutions collection alongside Atelier, Microbaffle, Acoustic Parquet, Quadra, Sound Quadra and CinemAtelier

Used in offices, schools, hospitality, residential and acoustic-treatment projects.

new_products.title: AT440
new_products.Description:
AT440 mini stereo amplifier

The AT440 is a Garvan Acoustic compact 2-channel stereo amplifier rated 440 W total. Built into a small form factor for residential and light-commercial installations, it drives Garvan in-wall, in-ceiling and on-wall speakers as well as the WA-series passive subwoofers at 8, 4 or 2 ohms without altering its power output.

  • 2 channels (stereo), 440 W total power
  • Compact form factor
  • Compatible with 8, 4 and 2 Ω loads
  • Companion product to the AT-series Powersoft DSP amplifier family

new_products.title: Amplifiers
new_products.Description:
Garvan Acoustic amplifier family

Garvan Acoustic builds a complete amplifier family designed to drive the entire Garvan speaker catalogue — including the passive subwoofer range — at 8, 4 or 2 ohms without altering the output power. The AT-series amplifiers are built around Powersoft DSP platforms and add input matrix, EQ, delay, limiter and frequency-range management; the higher-end models also support Dante / AES67 networked audio for IP-based installations.

  • 2-channel models: AT232-A, AT260-A
  • 4-channel models: AT432-A, AT432-D, AT460-A, AT460-D
  • High-power 4-channel models: AT2404-A, AT4804-A
  • Compact stereo model: AT440

Catalogue page covering the full amplifier line.
